period.source: TradingView OANDA:XAUUSD, archived OHLC merged with latest fetched completed candles
period.definition: Entire T1/T2/T3 pattern and all intervening M15 candles fit within an earlier candle high/low including wicks; mother precedes the entire pattern; stop at any missing M15 candle. Inclusive edges with at least one strictly inside edge. Nearest enclosing mother recorded.
period.strategy: Current Scalp 1:1 functions: H4 structure and EMA20/50, H1 continuation/Far, volume decrease >=250, 10/25% pullback legs, original fixed exits, 75-minute entry expiry, 300-pip per-leg limit.
period.counting: One signal is one setup; 10% and 25% entries additionally counted as separate legs. TP/SL setup requires at least one confirmed filled leg and no uncertain or conflicting leg outcome.
period.scope: Chart simulations, not MT5 executions. OHLC ordering ambiguity and missing candles remain uncertain. No spread, commission, slippage or live operational/session restrictions applied. Trading code/settings unchanged.

method.scope: Paired counterfactual on the same 34 baseline-identified overlapping later setups, including 2 originally unfilled setups. All 34 had a same-direction earlier trade open by the strict known-fill/known-exit rule. All other setups are outside this paired comparison.
method.entries: Baseline 10%/25%, candidate 20% / 40% of later setup final confirmation body, measured from immediate next M15 open. Risk weights stay 60% first leg / 40% second; unused allocation is not transferred.
method.exits: Original common stop and target remain fixed. 75-minute limit-entry window, cancellation at original exit, maximum entry-to-stop 30 price units. Outcome paths replayed with production scalpPullbackBarStates over continuous completed M15 candles.
method.accounting: 1R is one fixed full-setup cash-risk allowance. Filled positions sized to their own entry-to-stop distance; TP earns risk share times actual entry-to-fixed-target RR, SL loses its risk share. No compounding, fees, spread, slippage, lot rounding, margin or daily risk restrictions.
method.selection: Overlap membership is held fixed from the baseline study, not dynamically recomputed under the candidate. A complete conditional portfolio replay must check whether altered fill times change which future signals count as overlapping. Same-exit-bar timing and uncertain earlier trades were excluded from the original cohort.
method.uncertainty: Enumerates OHLC-consistent paths; reports min/max gross R when fill order is ambiguous. No assumption that high or low happened first.
method.interpretation: In-sample comparison selected after observing these data; not evidence of future or cost-adjusted profitability. Trading code/settings remain unchanged.
